subtype: Eyebrows in teasing and flirt-free banter [Expressing]
passage: On the tram in Prague, Jana said she would be up at six to revise for tomorrow's test. Camila arched one eyebrow slowly. "You? At six?" Jana burst into laughter. "Okay, okay, seven!" They had done this dozens of times. The eyebrow meant, of course you will. But at the next stop, Nadia, a new girl who had joined their table that week, said she planned to try out for the school choir. Camila raised the same eyebrow, and Nadia went stiff and looked at her shoes. Jana leaned over quickly. "Camila, it is banter, she does not know you yet," and Camila said, "Sorry, Nadia. That was a joke, I think you will get in."

qa.q: At what time did Jana say she would wake up to revise?
qa.a: Jana said she would be up at six to revise.

qa.q: What did Nadia feel when Camila raised an eyebrow at her?
qa.a: She stiffened and looked at her shoes, so she probably felt unsure or stung, since she did not know Camila's joking style yet. She might also have been simply shy.

qa.q: What did Camila do to repair the moment?
qa.a: Camila apologised, said the eyebrow was a joke and told Nadia, "I think you will get in."

qa.q: How does the same eyebrow look different to Jana than to Nadia?
qa.a: For Jana it is a known joke from many past laughs, while for Nadia, who is new, it could look like doubt or mockery.

grounding: A teenager raises an eyebrow in banter, which friends read as a joke, but it can sting if the target is unsure.

subtype: Eyebrows in teasing and flirt-free banter [Expressing]
passage: After training at the sports club, the coach announced that Tushar would take the first penalty on Saturday. Omkar arched one eyebrow at him, half a grin on his face. "You, taking a penalty? Sure you can find the goal?" Tushar laughed and shoved him. It was their usual game. But on the pitch the next day, when Tushar sent a shot high over the bar in front of the whole squad, Omkar raised the same eyebrow. Tushar's smile flickered. He was not sure this time whether Omkar was joking or judging him. Afterwards he said quietly, "When you do that eyebrow now, I do not know what you mean." Omkar said, "I was teasing. Sorry."

qa.q: Who would take the first penalty on Saturday?
qa.a: The coach announced that Tushar would take the first penalty on Saturday.

qa.q: What did Tushar feel when Omkar raised his eyebrow after the missed shot?
qa.a: His smile flickered, so he was unsure whether it was banter or judgement. It could still have been a joke, but the setting made it harder to tell.

qa.q: What did Tushar do that helped clear things up?
qa.a: He told Omkar honestly that he did not know what the eyebrow meant now, and Omkar explained and apologised.

qa.q: How might Omkar have meant the eyebrow after the missed shot?
qa.a: He said he was teasing, so he probably meant it as a friendly joke, without noticing the timing made it feel different.

grounding: A teenager uses a raised eyebrow in banter, friends read it through tone, and it can sting if the target is unsure it is playful.
